notes.v1_08: Covered Wagon: Replace the pebbles, the grey rock and the white flowers with a smooth, plain dirt road and soft grass with a few broad tufts. Make the shadow under the wagon slightly shorter and softer. Paint the wagon box as smooth planks with no bolt heads. Keep the wagon, the red wheels, the canvas cover, the hills, the sky and the view.
notes.v1_10: Campfire: Remove the blue kettle and show a plain stone in its place. Replace the log cabin with soft pine trees and bushes. Replace the scattered pebbles with smooth, plain warm dirt. Keep the fire, the logs, the stone ring, the grass tufts and the view.
notes.v1_09: Windmill: Replace the field of individual wheat ears with a smooth golden wheat mass in a few broad, soft bands, with only a few stalks drawn along the bottom edge. Paint the tower beams smooth matte red-brown with no rivets, and make their right faces slightly lighter. Keep the windmill, the white wheel, the yellow vane, the sky and the view.
